boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations on campus-adjacent downtown Lawrence corridors, each with a directly sourced reason to stop.

cards.title: See Douglas County history at Watkins
cards.subtitle: 1047 Massachusetts Street — Mass Street corridor
cards.notes: Walk to the former city hall at 1047 Massachusetts Street and explore its history galleries during the museum’s posted Tuesday–Saturday hours.
cards.short_summary: A free downtown history museum in the former city hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Watkins Museum lists free admission, its 1047 Massachusetts Street location, and Tuesday–Saturday hours.
cards.access_notes: Admission is free; posted hours are Tuesday–Saturday, 10 a.m.–4 p.m.

cards.title: Take the gazebo-and-gardens loop
cards.subtitle: 1141 Massachusetts Street — Mass Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the paths around the William Kelly Bandstand, Roosevelt Fountain, flower gardens, and Butterfly Garden; bring a picnic or a sketchbook.
cards.short_summary: A historic city park split across Massachusetts Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The City identifies South Park at 1141 Massachusetts Street and lists its bandstand, fountain, gardens, playground, and picnic tables.
cards.source_title: South Park – City of Lawrence, Kansas
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public park; check City notices and event schedules before visiting.

cards.title: Check the galleries and arts calendar
cards.subtitle: 940 New Hampshire Street — New Hampshire corridor
cards.notes: Step into the Arts Center’s main building to see current exhibitions or choose a class, performance, or film program that fits your schedule.
cards.short_summary: A multidisciplinary arts center with exhibitions, classes, and performances.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lawrence Arts Center says its 940 New Hampshire Street facility offers exhibitions, arts education, and performances.
cards.source_title: Art Facilities in Lawrence – Lawrence Arts Center
cards.access_notes: The Center posts regular building hours; ticketed programs and classes may require purchase.

cards.title: Use the downtown library as a reset stop
cards.subtitle: 707 Vermont Street — Vermont Street corridor
cards.notes: Browse collections, use the building map, or plan a quiet break at the library; bike racks and a bike fix-it station are listed nearby.
cards.short_summary: A downtown public-library stop with collections and visitor amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: Lawrence Public Library lists its 707 Vermont Street address, bike racks, and a bike fix-it station near the garage entrance.
cards.access_notes: Check the library’s current hours before arrival.

cards.title: Browse records and music media
cards.subtitle: 822 Massachusetts Street — Mass Street corridor
cards.notes: Stop in to browse the record store’s CDs, LPs, and tapes, or check its in-store-events listing before heading down the 800 block.
cards.short_summary: A Mass Street record store with physical music and in-store events.
cards.evidence_claim: Love Garden describes itself as a full-service record store buying, selling, and trading CDs, LPs, and more at 822 Massachusetts Street.
cards.access_notes: Posted store hours are Monday–Saturday 10 a.m.–8 p.m. and Sunday 11 a.m.–7 p.m.

cards.title: Browse handmade art across two floors
cards.subtitle: 825 Massachusetts Street — Mass Street corridor
cards.notes: Visit the gallery’s two floors to look at handmade work, then check its event page if your visit lands on a Final Friday.
cards.short_summary: A historic-downtown gallery representing artists in many media.
cards.evidence_claim: Phoenix Gallery lists its downtown location at 825 Massachusetts Street and says visitors can browse two floors of art.
cards.source_title: Welcome to Phoenix Gallery | Lawrence, KS
cards.access_notes: Check the gallery’s posted hours before visiting; artwork is offered for sale.

cards.title: Find a toy-store stop in the 900 block
cards.subtitle: 936 Massachusetts Street — Mass Street corridor
cards.notes: Add this named 900-block shop to a downtown walk when you want to browse toys; confirm current store details directly before making a special trip.
cards.short_summary: A named toy retailer on the northern Mass Street blocks.
cards.evidence_claim: Downtown Lawrence Inc.’s business directory lists The Toy Store at 936 Massachusetts Street.
cards.access_notes: Retail destination; verify current hours with the business.

cards.title: Browse the 800-block antique mall
cards.subtitle: 830 Massachusetts Street — Mass Street corridor
cards.notes: Make this a browsing stop while walking the 800 block, especially if you want time to look through antiques and vintage items at your own pace.
cards.short_summary: An antiques destination in the central Mass Street retail stretch.
cards.evidence_claim: Downtown Lawrence Inc.’s business directory lists Lawrence Antique Mall at 830 Massachusetts Street.
cards.access_notes: Retail destination; verify current hours with the business.

cards.title: Plan an outdoor-gear browse
cards.subtitle: 804 Massachusetts Street — Mass Street corridor
cards.notes: Use this 800-block shop as a practical stop when preparing for an outdoor activity or looking to browse bikes and outdoor equipment downtown.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor and bicycle retailer on Mass Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Downtown Lawrence Inc.’s business directory lists Sunflower Outdoor & Bike at 804 Massachusetts Street.
cards.access_notes: Retail destination; verify current hours and service availability with the business.

cards.title: Browse instruments in the 1300 block
cards.subtitle: 1347 Massachusetts Street — Mass Street corridor
cards.notes: Extend a Mass Street walk south to this named music shop when you want to browse instruments or music-related gear in a storefront setting.
cards.short_summary: A music retailer at the southern end of the downtown Mass Street stretch.
cards.evidence_claim: Downtown Lawrence Inc.’s business directory lists Mass Street Music at 1347 Massachusetts Street.
cards.access_notes: Retail destination; verify current hours with the business.
